info.description: Enterprise-grade analytics platform providing data upload, cleaning, quality assessment, analytics, reporting, AI-powered business insights, Power BI integration, REST APIs, and Streamlit dashboard visualisation.

post.description:
Register a new user with secure password hashing.

The role is assigned server-side and cannot be chosen by the caller; a
payload carrying `role` (or any other unknown field) is rejected with 422.
New accounts have the read-only VIEWER role. Returns 403 when
self-registration is disabled.

post.description:
Revoke the caller's own Bearer token.

Requires a valid token (401 otherwise). Previously anonymous callers could
post arbitrary strings here and each one was stored forever (SEC-09).

Change the caller's password. Every existing session, including this one,
is signed out; sign in again with the new password.
Invalidate every access token issued to the caller, on every device.

PipelineRequest.title: PipelineRequest
PipelineRequest.description:
Request model for pipeline execution.

The dataset is referenced ONLY by the server-issued identifier returned
from `POST /api/datasets`. There is no path field, and unknown fields are
rejected: the previous `input_path` let a client make the server read any
file it could reach.

UserRegistration.title: UserRegistration
UserRegistration.description:
Public self-registration schema.

There is deliberately no `role` field, and unknown fields are rejected
rather than ignored: accepting a caller-supplied role let an anonymous
request register an ADMIN account. The role of a self-registered account
is decided server-side (`UserService.SELF_REGISTRATION_ROLE`); privileged
roles are granted only through the admin user-management API.
